_comment: 1223 N Edgemont St, East Hollywood. The test case for this tool.
This file contains ONLY figures published by a local broker
about the January 2026 sale. It deliberately does NOT contain a rent roll, an
expense schedule, a land value or a construction cost, because none of those
were published. The tool's job on this file is to compute what it can, refuse
what it cannot, and state what the published headline figures imply about the
Everything else in the report — units, building area, lot size, year built,
AIN, and the seller's assessed value — is fetched live from the LA County
Assessor at run time and is not in this file.
notes: The published figures for this deal: $339,000/unit, $387/sf, ~10.5x gross, ~6.5% cap after tax reassessment, replacement cost ~$7.3M against a broker's $8.5M.
The $8.5M broker replacement figure is recorded here as context but is not used as an input; only the $7.3M figure is passed to the solver.
Rentable area of 12,280 sf is the marketed figure. The Assessor carries 14,680 sf of building area for this parcel. The report shows both.
